text:
Alex Rivera: Quick passoff — Orbital Systems (Enterprise) closed yesterday. PoC complete, they want a private deployment in eu-west-1, SSO (Okta) + SCIM, and Dedicated GPU capacity. Estimate ~5M tokens/mo once ramped. Renewal is 12 months; exec check-in scheduled 2026-06-12. Known risks: data residency questions, HIPAA review flagged, and potential latency issues for long-context queries (>2k tokens). Contract link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=orbital-contract :paperclip:
Maya Chen: Thanks Alex — assigning owners and kicking off handover. Can you paste the handoff doc and primary contacts here? Also confirm preferred kickoff window next week.
Alex Rivera: Handoff doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OrbitalPassoff
Main tech blockers: SAML metadata not provided by customer yet, they use Okta with a custom attribute mapping. They asked for an admin training and a runbook for fallback to hosted models. Contact at Orbital: Priya Sharma (VP Prod) priya@orbital.com, Tom Keller (Infra) tom.k@orbital.com.
Maya Chen: Owned — Jordan will be CSM lead, Samir (eng-support) will triage SSO/private infra, Linh will own enablement and training. Proposed kickoff: 2026-06-09 10:00 PT (30m). @Jordan @Samir @Linh please confirm availability.
Jordan Park: Confirmed for 6/9 10am PT. I'll start a 2-week adoption/ramp plan draft and owners matrix.
Samir Patel: I'll open an internal triage ticket and ask infra for ephemeral access. Need the customer's SAML metadata and a test Okta account. Creating RED-7432 to track. Also: please share any logs of high-latency generation calls (sample request + response times).
Alex Rivera: Adding Tom's Okta admin: tom.k@orbital.com — he said he'll send metadata by EOD tomorrow. Priya wants the admin training for 6 users and the SLA doc.
Samir Patel: RED-7432 created -> https://redwood.internal/tickets/RED-7432
To validate integration, run this locally against their SAML assertion endpoint:

curl -v "https://orbital-okta.example.com/saml2" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" -d @saml-request.xml

Also we may need a runtime config for long-context models — tagging @eng-runtime for seq > 2k behavior. I recommend quantization profile Q4_0 for cost; will confirm after baseline tests.
Linh Tran: I'll put together a two-session enablement: (1) admin + SSO/SCIM setup walkthrough, (2) product training for end-users (prompts, templates, error handling). Prefer week of 6/15 for the user session. Need list of 6 admin emails and one Slack channel to join for ongoing enablement.
Jordan Park: Renewal risk note — Orbital's roadmap ties product launch to our Dedicated commit. If Dedicated capacity pricing isn't competitive they may delay. I'll request a pricing/commitment scenario from Sales by EOD so we can model impact on renewal. Action: Jordan -> finalize ramp plan; Sales -> pricing scenarios; CS -> onboarding milestones.
Maya Chen: Action items (quick):
- Jordan: ramp plan + risk mitigation doc (due 2026-06-04)
- Samir: SSO triage + RED-7432 updates (start now, first update 2026-06-02)
- Linh: enablement plan + session slides (draft by 2026-06-08)
- Alex: get SAML metadata + Okta test creds (ETA 2026-06-02)
- Jordan/Maya: schedule executive check-in prep (prep note by 2026-06-10)
Please reply with thumbs up if you accept ownership or drop a delegate.
calendar-bot: Event "Orbital Kickoff (30m)" created — 2026-06-09 10:00 PT. Invite sent to: maya@redwood.com, jordan@redwood.com, samir@redwood.com, linh@redwood.com, alex@redwood.com, priya@orbital.com
Alex Rivera: Got it — tom will send metadata tomorrow, Priya confirmed admin list. Thanks team :pray:
Maya Chen: Great — I'll track these in the account playbook and add the renewal risk tag. If RED-7432 surfaces infra blockers we escalate to eng-runtime immediately. :white_check_mark:
Jordan Park: Adding a small prompt-set evaluation to the ramp plan so we can monitor quality regressions during quantization testing.
Samir Patel: Noted. If anyone has sample payloads, drop in RED-7432. I'll run baseline latency/throughput tests as soon as we get access.
Alex Rivera: Will add sample requests to the ticket. Thanks everyone!
